text: Amadeus Memory 是 DSH Web 的长期记忆与知识图谱插件。它接入 DSH 工具、系统提示和 Web 面板，将偏好、项目状态、决策与经历保存到跨会话记忆中，并提供关键词或向量检索、自动摘要与 Dream 巩固，以及按 Workspace 授权的 Learn/Borrow 会话共享。适合希望 DSH 延续项目背景、查找过往决策并管理会话间知识访问的用户。使用宿主模型完成摘要和巩固；向量检索需配置 embedding 服务，也可选本地 embedding。

Amadeus Memory adds persistent memory to DSH Web. Save preferences and project decisions, then retrieve them by keyword or vector search. Summaries use the host model. A web panel manages memory and Learn/Borrow sharing. Vector search needs an embedding provider; local embedding is optional.
想让 DSH 在不同会话之间记住项目决定和个人偏好。
我想保存长期记忆，之后还能按关键词或语义找回来。
如何让 DSH 自动把对话整理成摘要并留作后续参考？
让一个工作区的会话在授权后学习另一个会话的知识。
I want DSH to remember project context across sessions.
Can I search my saved memories by meaning as well as keywords?
Amadeus Memory 的功能「跨会话记忆」：通过 DSH 工具保存偏好、项目状态、决策和经验，供后续会话检索与注入。由模型调用 memory_save 写入；输入类型、标题和正文，可附标签与重要性。
Amadeus Memory 的功能「记忆检索」：用户或模型可按文本搜索已有条目，并选择关键词、向量或混合模式；结果包含条目和时间信息。通过 memory_search 提供查询，可选时间范围和结果数量。
Amadeus Memory 的功能「会话间授权共享」：在 Workspace 中配置方向性的 Learn 或 Borrow 访问，让会话使用获授权的知识，并区分保留学习成果与随来源授权撤销的借用内容。通过插件提供的会话授权面板管理。

@fg-lab/amadeus-memory README · Release status：**1.3.0 is published:** [GitHub Release](https://github.com/jeskoky-pixel/amadeus-memory/releases/tag/v1.3.0) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fg-lab/amadeus-memory). Install the pinned version and verify the release checksum. Later main changes do not change this immutable archive. See [publishing policy](docs/PUBLISHING.md).

@fg-lab/amadeus-memory README · What you can do：- Keep recent conversation context with Hot Memory; optionally enable Recent Activity and Core Memory for cross-session activity and deliberately curated facts.
- Save long-term facts and experiences; retrieve them with BM25, vector or hybrid search. Vector search needs a configured embedding provider.
- Browse a shared knowledge graph, entities and aliases, and tune Tag/Entity importance. Session authorization still controls which source material may be read.
- Use Mneme automatic summaries and Dream consolidation, with optional Sleep processing. These use configured model services and are not a promise of offline processing.
- Bind one Workspace. Sessions are private by default in unified ACL mode; grant directional Learn or Borrow access from the fifth Amadeus page. Inspect derived-knowledge provenance and preview a Session's graph.
- Learn permits authorized derived knowledge to remain after source access is revoked; Borrow remains dependent on source access. Learning does not grant unrestricted onward sharing.

@fg-lab/amadeus-memory README · What you can do：Example: let a planning Session learn selected project context from a research Session, then revoke source access. Authorized learned facts can remain; unlearned source content becomes inaccessible. Choose Borrow when continued access must depend on the original grant.

@fg-lab/amadeus-memory README · What you can do：Hot Memory is enabled by default. Recent Activity, Core Memory and Memory's optional persona card are disabled by default; Sleep is optional. Confirm the unified ACL Workspace and grants before QQ use. Memory can run without QQ for ordinary DSH Sessions. QQ identity is accepted only through its trusted Host contract.

@fg-lab/amadeus-memory README · What you can do：Amadeus Memory is based on Mneme. See [upstream source and attribution](UPSTREAM.md); original memory, consolidation and retrieval capabilities are not presented as new Amadeus inventions.

@fg-lab/amadeus-memory README · Install and configure：Install the prebuilt `.tgz` with the official DSH plugin manager into your selected Profile. No local source build is required. Follow [installation instructions](docs/INSTALL_V1_2.md); do not copy configuration into a running Profile by hand.

Select a Workspace and configure Session ACL sharing. Learn retains authorized derived knowledge; Borrow is revoked with its source access.

@fg-lab/amadeus-memory README · Install and configure：Memory is now a root-level package; no GitHub subdirectory suffix is needed. Its internal ID remains `dsh-mneme`: do not load original Mneme alongside it.

@fg-lab/amadeus-memory README · Interface：This is a recorded interface screenshot, not evidence that every real platform capability passed the current release gate. See the detailed reference and verification reports for limitations.

@fg-lab/amadeus-memory README · Upgrade and recovery：Back up user data before upgrading. Code, persistent user data and recovery backups are separate. Disable stops functionality; uninstall is intended to retain external data. Restoring old code alone does not reverse a database migration.

text: @fg-lab/amadeus-memory README · 隐私承诺：`autoDream` 与 `autoSummarize` 的巩固和摘要走宿主模型；默认 Embedding 配置也可能访问远端服务。只有显式选择本地 Embedding 并安装本地运行时，语义向量才在本机计算。插件不向 Amadeus 自有服务器传送记忆正文。

@fg-lab/amadeus-memory README · Privacy：`autoDream` and `autoSummarize` use the host model for consolidation and summaries. The configured embedding provider may be remote. Semantic vectors stay local only when local embedding is explicitly selected and its runtime is installed. The plugin does not send memory bodies to an Amadeus-owned server.

软件包不携带用户数据库、QQ Token 或模型密钥。用户数据位于插件安装目录之外；卸载代码不等于删除数据。旧版代码未必能读取已迁移的数据库，回滚时须配套恢复升级前备份。详情见 [中文指南](docs/USER_GUIDE.zh.md)、[备份与回滚](docs/BACKUP_ROLLBACK.md)。

@fg-lab/amadeus-memory README · 能帮你做什么：- Hot Memory 保留近期上下文；按需开启近期动态与 Core Memory，记录跨会话活动和人工精选的重要事实。
- 保存长期事实与经历，通过 BM25、向量或混合检索查找。向量检索需要配置 Embedding 服务。
- 浏览统一知识图谱、实体与别名，调整 Tag/Entity 权重；共享图谱不等于绕过 Session 来源权限。
- 复用 Mneme 自动摘要与 Dream 巩固，并可选启用 Sleep；模型处理可能访问已配置的远端服务。
- 绑定一个 Workspace，在第五页 Amadeus 管理方向性 Learn/Borrow 授权，查看派生知识来源及按 Session 预览图谱。
- Learn 允许合法学习成果在撤销源访问后保留；Borrow 随源访问撤销而失效。学习不代表获得任意转分享权。

示例：让规划会话学习研究会话的项目背景，再撤销源访问。已合法形成的学习成果可保留，未学习的源内容不可继续读取；需要随授权一起失效时选择 Borrow。

@fg-lab/amadeus-memory README · 能帮你做什么：Hot Memory 默认开启；近期动态、Core Memory 和 Memory 自带的可选人格卡默认关闭，Sleep 为可选功能。QQ 使用前应核对统一 ACL 工作区及授权。普通 DSH 会话无需安装 QQ；QQ 身份只接受可信 Host 契约。

Amadeus Memory 基于 Mneme，原版记忆、巩固及检索能力不冒称 Amadeus 原创，见[上游署名](UPSTREAM.md)。
